name: Voxel explainer
description: A voxel world built on ONE grid: 0.1 m cubes for people and props, 0.2 m terrain, 0.4 m trees and houses. Golden-hour valley with a cabin, pond, lanterns, drifting voxel clouds, falling leaves and fireflies; chunky voxel people with real elbows, knees and a face made of voxels. Explainers, how-tos and stories.
rules: One grid: 0.1 m cubes for people and props, 0.2 m for terrain, 0.4 m for trees and buildings. Never mix a smooth model into the scene.
Layers: foreground props, the action plane, trees and cabin, far hills. Depth comes from overlapping layers and atmospheric blue in the distance.
Golden-hour light from the front-left with long soft shadows; lanterns and windows are the only warm practicals.
The face is made of voxels (eyes, brows, mouth swap states): keep expressions bold and readable, never subtle.
Elbows and knees bend; hands and feet are blocks. Poses come from the shared gesture library.
Ambient life is the motion: clouds, chimney smoke, falling leaves, fireflies, lantern flicker. Camera moves are rare and each has a reason.
Captions: bold white with a thick dark outline and one yellow word.
camera_language: Low and friendly. Wide to show the valley and the person in it, medium three-quarter for talking, medium-wide three-quarter for hands-on actions so arm and object both show. Close-ups only on the face for a reaction. The world moves by itself (clouds, smoke, leaves, fireflies) so the camera can stay still.
typography: Heavy sans, white with yellow accent.
audio_direction: upbeat groove, pop on card, tick on step chip, hop = boing
pitfalls: The big voxel head makes extreme close-ups look cartoonish: stay at medium-close-up or wider.
Over-the-shoulder hides the object behind the head: use medium-wide three-quarter.
Golden-hour bloom washes colours: keep bloom at or below 0.2 in close shots.
